notes.title: Update 2.318 live!
notes.content:
Stablility fixes.
Memory leaks fixed.
Physics bug fixed.
Sim fixes and updates (from so7).

notes.title: Eat, Sleep, Bet, Repeat V2 now released!
notes.content:
[b]ESBR get's a massive free update: [/b]

[list]
Races are now in full 3D (with over 50 3D racecourses). This replaces the old commentary only screen.
The game also uses the latest horse racing simulation engine for improved realism.
Various menu improvements and tweaks.
Please report any issues.
[/list]


[i]Please note that old saves are not compatible with this release.[/i]
